notes: Fixture root is a throwaway git repo of synthetic review records (scratchpad/router-fixture). Iteration 1 (evals 1-3): cases where correct behavior never launches a fan-out; ran with/without skill. Iteration 2 (evals 4-7, from the independent 2026-07-30 review): harder cases — a gate stop whose prompt does NOT forbid launching, an append-only records repair, the post-cert routing regression, and a records-discipline mock pass. Still owed beyond fixtures: one supervised real verification pass end to end, which happens at the next real loop use. 'Until a gate' chaining stays off until iteration 2 + the supervised real pass are marked PASSED here.
